_doc: Raw controls the static audit cannot see a look for, one entry per file with the reason. Adding one needs a reason.
frontend/src/components/common/CopyButto: Shared component; the caller passes the class that styles it (and the `Copy` text buttons are Button-like by that class).
frontend/src/components/graph/GraphOptio: Menu items styled by the attribute selector [role^=menuitem]; the audit only reads class and tag selectors.
frontend/src/components/layout/KeymapEdi: Search input mounted only inside SettingsPanel's Dialog, whose :global input rules style it.
